queries_run: Silicon Motion SIMO customer Kioxia Micron PHISEMI credit downgrade OR guidance cut 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 前五大客戶占營收約66%（2023:61%、2024:66%）；>10%客戶合計58%（四家：PHISEMI、Kioxia、AFASTOR、Micron）；前十大客戶82%。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 Item 3 / 財報附註
findings.excerpt: Sales to our five largest customers represented approximately 61%, 66% and 66% of our net revenue in 2023, 2024 and 2025, respectively. Sales to our customers constituting more than 10% of our net revenue represented, in the aggregate, 45%, 57% and 58% of our net revenue in 2023, 2024 and 2025, respectively.

findings.claim: 公司稱應收帳款信用集中風險受信用評估、短收款期及客戶高信用度緩解；前十大客戶占比 2023-2025 為75%、84%、82%。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 財報附註
findings.excerpt: The Company believes that the concentration of credit risk in its accounts receivable is substantially mitigated by the Company’s credit evaluation process, relatively short collection terms and the high level of credit worthiness of its customers.

findings.claim: 搜尋未見SIMO主要客戶信用降評或財務惡化報導；Benzinga 稱 2026-07-29 給 Q3 2026 營收指引 $519M-$541M，較先前區間上調。
findings.source: Benzinga SIMO earnings forecasts（搜尋摘要）
